structures.name: Right lung
structures.limitations: Schematic placeholder only; not a scan-derived lung.
structures.studyNote: The right lung is the three-lobed lung in the right pleural cavity.

structures.name: Left lung
structures.limitations: Schematic placeholder only; not a scan-derived lung.
structures.studyNote: The left lung accommodates the heart through its cardiac notch.

structures.name: Heart
structures.limitations: No anatomical heart mesh is included in this build.
structures.studyNote: The heart lies obliquely in the middle mediastinum.

structures.name: Thoracic cage
structures.limitations: Placeholder bounds only; it is not a rib mesh.
structures.studyNote: The thoracic cage protects thoracic viscera and supports respiration.

structures.name: Trachea
structures.limitations: Schematic metadata entry only; a verified production mesh is not included in this build.
structures.studyNote: The trachea bifurcates at the carina into the main bronchi.

structures.name: Esophagus
structures.limitations: Schematic metadata entry only; a verified production mesh is not included in this build.
structures.studyNote: The esophagus descends posterior to the trachea toward the diaphragm.

structures.name: Diaphragm
structures.limitations: Schematic metadata entry only; a verified production mesh is not included in this build.
structures.studyNote: The diaphragm forms the inferior boundary of the thoracic cavity.

structures.name: Sternum
structures.limitations: Schematic metadata entry only; a verified production mesh is not included in this build.
structures.studyNote: The sternum consists of manubrium, body, and xiphoid process.

structures.name: Right main bronchus
structures.limitations: Schematic metadata entry only; a verified production mesh is not included in this build.
structures.studyNote: The right main bronchus is wider, shorter, and more vertical than the left.

structures.name: Left main bronchus
structures.limitations: Schematic metadata entry only; a verified production mesh is not included in this build.
structures.studyNote: The left main bronchus passes inferior to the arch of the aorta.

structures.name: Aortic arch
structures.limitations: Fine vessel geometry requires a dedicated verified detail mesh.
structures.studyNote: The aortic arch curves posteriorly and to the left over the left main bronchus.

structures.name: Superior vena cava
structures.limitations: Fine vessel geometry requires a dedicated verified detail mesh.
structures.studyNote: The superior vena cava returns blood from the upper body to the right atrium.
